offering_description.value: Publishes sports, personal finance, entertainment and lifestyle coverage for online readers. It sells advertising and sponsored content to marketers, offers paid investment commentary, and earns commissions on shopping referrals. It also sells consumer merchandise through an online storefront.

primary_products.value: Digital articles and newsletters; paid investment research; jewelry; beauty products; home goods

primary_services.value: Digital advertising; sponsored content production; affiliate marketing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Consumer brands, advertising agencies and online merchants; B2C: Sports fans, entertainment and lifestyle readers, individual investors and online shoppers

end_markets.value: Sports media; personal finance and investing; entertainment and lifestyle media; digital advertising; consumer e-commerce

revenue_model.value: advertising: Display and video placements, sponsorships and branded content across its publications; commissions or management fees: Merchant commissions on purchases referred through shopping articles and product recommendations; subscription: Paid access to investment analysis, trading commentary and newsletters; product sales: Jewelry, beauty products and home goods ordered through its online storefront
revenue_model.category: advertising; commissions or management fees; subscription; product sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Turns reporting and contributor coverage into publications for readers and sells access to those audiences to advertisers; software / platform: Hosts and monetizes digital publications for publishing partners; retailer: Sources consumer merchandise from vendors and sells it to online shoppers

geography_served.value: US national: Primarily serves readers, advertisers and shoppers across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Sports, finance, entertainment and lifestyle publishing, plus online retail linked to shopping content

distribution_channels.value: online: Owned publication websites, email newsletters, social feeds and an online storefront; direct sales: In-house sales teams selling campaigns to advertisers and agencies; partners / resellers: Programmatic advertising exchanges and third-party content syndication platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Digital advertising and e-commerce are subject to FTC disclosure rules and state consumer privacy laws

notes: The current scope of the online retail assortment and publishing partnerships is uncertain.
